programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Take in a Runaway Kitty!; Pups Save the Cheese Goat!
programs.desc: When Rocky Kitty runs away and tries to join the "PAW Patrol," he helps the pups rescue Humdinger and the kitties from a hang-glider ride; when the Good Neighbor Robots confuse Farmer Al's request, they wind up being the target of a hungry eagle.

programs.title: Peppa Pig
programs.sub_title: Captain Daddy Pig; The Power Cut; Bouncy Ball; Stars; Daddy Pig's Birthday
programs.desc: Peppa's family spends a day on the river; the lights go out at Peppa's house; Peppa and George play with a bouncy ball; the sky is full of stars at night; the family celebrates Daddy Pig's birthday.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Mighty Pups, Charged Up: Pups Stop a Big Bad Bot; Mighty Pups, Charged Up: Mighty Pups Versus the Dome
programs.desc: When Harold Humdinger uses a giant robot to take the buildings of Adventure Bay and make his own town, the Mighty Pups must save the day; the Copycat is back, and Adventure Bay needs a Mighty Rescue when he traps the entire town.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Mighty Pups, Super Paws: Pups and the Big Twin Trick; Mighty Pups, Super Paws: Pups Save the Mega Mayor
programs.desc: The Ladybird is up to her old tricks again, but this time the Mighty Twins have a super trick of their own; Mayor Humdinger finally gets superpowers, and it's a total cat-astrophe.

programs.title: Mr. Crocodile
programs.sub_title: Tooth on the Loose; Scaredy Croc
programs.desc: Mr. Crocodile worries he'll be caught between his old best friend Buzzy and his new best friend Daisy; Mr. Crocodile, Daisy, and their friends are scared to fetch Martin's gloves from his spooky shed.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Rescue Wheels: Pups Save the Risky Race; Rescue Wheels: Pups Save the Runaway Truck
programs.desc: When Boomer challenges Roxi in a race to the top of a mountain, his reckless driving causes an avalanche of boulders.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save a Disappearing Flounder; Pups Save Little Grandpa and Mr. Alex
programs.desc: When Cap'n Turbot's ship disappears, the PAW Patrol must venture into the mysterious Adventure Bay Triangle to find the missing vessel; when Alex and Mr. Porter swap roles, the pups must help track down the Mini-Patrol after they go missing.

programs.title: Rubble & Crew
programs.sub_title: The Crew Builds a Splash Park; The Crew Builds a Playroom
programs.desc: The pups have to get creative to cool down; the crew builds a playroom for Lucas and Lily, but a visitor causes complications.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save the Dizzy Dust Express; Pups Save the Treetop Trekkers
programs.desc: When the Dizzy Dust Express appears with no one aboard, the PAW Patrol must stop the runaway train and find the missing passengers; Ms. Marjorie, Tilly Turbot and Mayor Goodway get stranded in the treetops on their jungle zip-lining adventure.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save the Chicken Conductor; Pups Save the Digi Tal Stylists
programs.desc: Chickaletta is left driving the train after an enormous chicken floaty launches Engineer Ed out the window; when Katie needs to close the Pet Parlor early, Digi and Tal volunteer to keep the shop open.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save Alex's Feathery Friends; Pups Save a Puffy Mayor
programs.desc: The "PAW Patrol" must rescue Mr. Porter and reunite an ostrich family before the big birds get into trouble; During Mayor Goodway's fashion show, the pups must save Farmer Al and Mayor Humdinger after Humdinger's puffy shirt floats away with them.

programs.title: The Smurfs
programs.sub_title: Smurfily Gmurfy; Smurf T for Thief
programs.desc: Baby Smurf finds Handy's cuckoo clock and ends up travelling through time; Chef Smurf must investigate when someone steals the festival cake.
